tasks.title: Shared API reads bound memory, refuse redirects and use fixed diagnostics
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, Behavior items 1-6, Tests and Completion evidence; Decisions 1-7 and 9; Required behavior R1-R5; Counterexamples; Disclosure rule; Scope verification; Performance impact; Security impact; Acceptance evidence items 1-4 and 6

acceptance.expected: Before the first edit, record the full implementation-base SHA in task evidence; retain this BASE for every scope and performance check.

Create this disposable Git fixture script outside every repository and prove the five checks in plan.md, Scope verification, before relying on them. Record each check separately in all seven states: clean control: checks 1-5 pass, check 1 empty; allowed committed: check 1 allowed singleton, checks 2-5 pass; protected unstaged: checks 3,4 detect, checks 1,2,5 pass; protected staged: checks 2,4 detect, checks 1,3,5 pass; protected staged then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 2,3,4 detect; protected committed with clean index/worktree: check 1 protected path, check 5 exit 1, checks 2-4 pass; protected committed then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 1,3,4,5 detect, check 2 passes. Use an allowed file and a protected file, verify exact-path rejection against this task’s lists, and delete fixture/script afterwards.

acceptance.command: bun test test/client.test.ts test/request-json.test.ts test/version.test.ts test/client-transport.test.ts test/client-memory.test.ts
acceptance.expected: Green candidate: 0 failed tests; focused coverage exit is not the acceptance gate. Cover the entire contract Tests section. Fixed invalid-JSON text is response body is not valid JSON, fixed wire text is x-pulse-contract: unsupported wire version, expected 1 at every surfaced location, with no upstream marker in serialized results. Existing wire ok/absent/mismatch decisions remain unchanged.

0 failed tests. Class: eager decompression / memory exhaustion. Cases: compressed read body larger than the cap is rejected with a bounded peak memory → network; compressed non-success read is dropped with a bounded peak memory → http; compressed successful write response larger than the cap is rejected with a bounded peak memory → network with response kept; compressed non-success write response is an http error with a bounded peak memory → http without message, response kept. Each peak RSS growth ≤64 MiB, input-generation CPU ≤0.1 s. Use the exact Peak RSS growth statistic in Counterexamples: isolated sequential children, Bun.gc(true) before baseline RSS, samples at least every 5 ms from just before the call until 1000 ms after return, maximum minus baseline divided by 2^20 and rounded down, no averaging. Each child uses process.execPath and imports ../src/index.ts; kill deadline 30 s, test timeout 60 s, output one JSON line with kind and growth. Report titles, outcomes, growth and CPU only.

0 failed tests. Class SSRF / redirect following: same-origin read redirect is refused, cross-origin read redirect is refused and https-to-http read redirect is refused each give ok false, http with the received status for 301,302,303,307,308, destination count 0 and no destination credential. Class eager decompression / fail-closed validation: encoded answer is refused with a fixed cause gives response content-encoding is not supported, no received header text and no validator call, covering real, unknown and multi-coding classes; small compressed body under the cap is network, never too-large or ok. Multi-coding header value is refused; non-canonical identity spelling and absent coding read normally. Precedence: mismatching wire on encoded 2xx is wire-mismatch; encoded 503 is http 503; non-2xx write is http without message and keeps response metadata; onWireAbsent once for an absent wire header. Identity body above the default cap is too-large, with or without declared length. Native Bun fetch, local-only execution and peer cleanup required. HTTPS-to-HTTP class keeps certificate verification enabled, no global TLS bypass, no committed key material or temporary files. Follow kit's test-only OpenSSL PATH-call lint convention; missing OpenSSL fails, never skips. Construction details belong only in runtime test code.

acceptance.command: git checkout "$BASE" -- src; bun test test/client.test.ts test/request-json.test.ts test/version.test.ts test/client-transport.test.ts test/client-memory.test.ts; git checkout HEAD -- src
acceptance.expected: After the fixed source is committed, retain candidate tests while running against BASE source, then restore candidate source even if the test command fails. Red evidence includes all four memory cases (growth above 64 MiB or wrong kind), the three redirect refusal titles (old destination count 1 and ok true), and both fixed-text cases. Record failing titles and measured numbers only. Do not claim failures caused only by coverage. Restore index and working tree before final scope checks.

acceptance.command: Review src/client.ts, src/version.ts and their injected-fetch/source-check regressions
acceptance.expected: Shared local init helper sends manual redirects, decompress false and accept-encoding identity for both functions, preserves other caller headers without mutation, and keeps requestJson JSON content type. Bun-only encoding refusal precedes all body reads with the spec's HTTP/wire/encoding/size/empty/JSON/validation precedence. No new src module or dist import, no node:/bun runtime import, no exported decompress type, no changed readText/cancellation/interruption/manual-incident semantics. SonarJS complexity ≤15. Test assertions use independent literals, never checkWireVersion output as the expected error text.

Exit 0 under Bun 1.4.0: lint, build, typecheck and full tests with 80% line coverage, including unchanged security tests and exported-type fixture. The mandatory OpenSSL TLS test runs without skipping.

acceptance.command: bun run build; git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: Fresh build exit 0; after generated dist is committed, diff exit 0. Required dist/client.js and dist/version.js committed; declaration files only if generated doc comments change.
Prints 0 (grep may exit 1 for no match).
Exactly 1	1	package.json; the only changed line sets version to 2.5.2.

Both required docs updated: add console to consumers/pin instructions, document per-runtime encoding policy, redirect statuses including browser status 0, both fixed texts, check order and non-successful encoded write handling; add the 2.5.2 patch note. Text agrees with Decisions 1-7.

Create/run/delete local evidence outside every repository with Node 24 and the built dist, and report Node version plus titles/outcomes only. Identity read and small compressed JSON read: ok; compressed answer above cap: too-large with peak growth ≤64 MiB; same-origin redirect: http with original 3xx status, destination count 0. Against BASE dist the redirect gives ok true and destination count 1. No script or hostile input retained or disclosed.

Create/run/delete local browser evidence outside every repository using Playwright 1.64.1 and Chromium with a browser bundle of built dist as specified in Completion evidence; use fetch.bind(globalThis). Runtime compatibility / decoded-cap cases: small gzip-compressed JSON and small brotli-compressed JSON → ok with independently asserted values; gzip answer above the cap and brotli answer above the cap → too-large. Redirect-following cases: same-origin redirect and cross-origin redirect → http status 0, destination count 0. Against BASE dist both redirect cases must give ok true, destination count 1, proving the evidence can fail. Report Chromium version, case titles, outcomes and call durations only. Test code chooses the local-only setup; no fixture construction details in task evidence. Delete scratch directory before scope checks; no external network during cases and no browser dependency or test committed.

Run three times on the recorded implementation base and three on the branch, on one machine under Bun 1.4.0. Record user + system seconds rounded to 0.01 s, each median and branch-minus-base delta; no means. Expected +0.6 to +1.0 s, contract.test_cpu_s budget 9.0 s and regression floor 2.0 s; fallback required above +1.5 s.

acceptance.command: git clone https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git "$SCRATCH/pulse-api"; (cd "$SCRATCH/pulse-api" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun bench/run.ts --a "$API_MAIN" --b "$API_MAIN" --others-ref main --b-ref "contract=$TARGET_REF" --rounds 1)
acceptance.expected: Conditional fallback only after the primary threshold is exceeded. The harness runs from the scratch api checkout, never this consumer or contract repository. Record the full api main SHA as API_MAIN for both sides and the public fetchable candidate branch/SHA as TARGET_REF; Docker with Compose, git and network required. Report contract's rows and compare to api/bench/budgets.json using the plan's budget/floor rule; no api metric is expected to move. Delete the scratch checkout afterwards. Do not use --b-ref console.

acceptance.command: Review task acceptance evidence and PR text against plan.md, Disclosure rule and Security impact
acceptance.expected: Public P2 security disclosure: findings security-contract-2026-11-03-1, -3, -4 and -5 name location, class, impact and fix direction only. Every security case in tasks, acceptance evidence and PR text is limited to title, class, expected outcome and budget. No working payload, fixture setup, server layout, routing, response order, header value, body content, encoder setting, response-construction steps or parameters, reproduction command, redirect recipe or oversized-response recipe. Test code alone chooses construction and builds hostile inputs at runtime. Audit all Counterexamples, including small compressed bodies, multi-coding header value, non-canonical identity spelling, precedence, body/header-text disclosure and Node/browser compatibility, against the current wording; no old fixture instructions survive. No new runtime or dev dependency, setting, exported name, result shape or wire version; timeout/abort behavior, default 5 MiB cap and caller maxBytes preserved.

acceptance.command: Review candidate security checklist and PR evidence
acceptance.expected: Exercise Security impact's secrets/error text, memory/body limits, redirects/caller-header containment, fail-closed coding and dependency-pin checks on the candidate. PR names version 2.5.2, four finding ids with location/class/impact/fix direction only, red/green checks, Node/browser outcomes, performance and scope evidence. Known browser limit documented: it cannot request identity and relies on decoding inside the capped stream.
